description: Gmail and Calendar pages take multiple seconds to load on a cold cache. description: Gemini chat rendered a half finished bubble with the literal text 'As a' and then stopped silently when the user asked '@gemini what's your favorite thing about @claude?'. Root cause: stream_gemini in api/services/chat_providers.py iterates chunks, appends text, then unconditionally sends a type:done event. It never reads candidates[0].finish_reason after the loop, so a SAFETY/RECITATION/MAX_TOKENS/PROHIBITED_CONTENT block is treated as a normal completion and the partial text becomes a stuck orphan bubble. For any other reason, send a type:error event with friendly plain-language copy keyed to the reason, include the partial text when meaningful, and log the real reason server-side.
